title: Included Upkeep by Plan: Community Rules & Site Care Comparison Chart
content:
The Community Rules & Site Care plan in force decides which upkeep the community's contractor performs on the home site. The chart reads across the six plans, from the Self-Maintained Site, on which the resident keeps the site, to the Complete Site Care Plan.

| Upkeep item | Self-Maintained Site | Lawn Mowing Plan | Lawn & Trim Plan | Full Lawn Care Plan | Full Lawn & Snow Care Plan | Complete Site Care Plan |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Mowing by the community's contractor | no | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Days between scheduled mowings in the growing season | not applicable | 7 | 7 | 7 | 7 | 7 |
| Edging and shrub trimming | no | no | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Lawn fertilization and weed control | no | no | no | yes | yes | yes |
| Fertilization and weed-control applications per calendar year | 0 | 0 | 0 | 4 | 4 | 5 |
| Autumn leaf removal | no | no | no | yes | yes | yes |
| Driveway and walk snow removal | no | no | no | no | yes | yes |
| Snowfall depth that triggers plan snow removal | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | 2.0 inches | 2.0 inches |
| Gutter cleaning, twice a year | no | no | no | no | no | yes |
| Skirting and siding wash, once a year | no | no | no | no | no | yes |
| Bulk debris pickups from the site per calendar year | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 2 |

## Notes on the chart

- "Not applicable" appears where the plan does not include the service the figure describes: there is no mowing interval without mowing and no snowfall trigger without snow removal.
- The mowing interval is the same 7 days on every plan that includes mowing; the plans differ in what they add to mowing.
- **Hypothetical illustration.** On the Complete Site Care Plan a resident has 2 bulk debris pickups in a calendar year; on every other plan the count is zero.
- **Hypothetical illustration.** On the Full Lawn & Snow Care Plan a snowfall reaching 2.0 inches triggers plan snow removal of the driveway and walks.
